The company demonstrates a very large scale with over $19 billion in revenue and $98 billion in assets, supported by solid profitability (14% operating margin and $2.4 billion in net income) and a healthy liquidity profile with a current ratio of 1.44. However, its capital structure is highly leveraged with total liabilities of $77.3 billion against shareholders' equity of $21.3 billion (debt-to-equity or leverage ratio is elevated), which restrains the rating from the highest investment-grade categories. Balance sheet strength is supported by substantial retained earnings of $65.4 billion, indicating a long track record of profitable operations and placing the credit firmly in the investment-grade BBB range.

DECISION: BBB
